verdict.rationale: SumUp's docs describe only static, account-wide API keys that let an app 'act on behalf of the merchant account' (sumup-docs-14, sumup-docs-37) with no mention of scopes, permission tiers, or per-agent least-privilege credentials, even though they do offer an MCP server/agent toolkit for AI use (sumup-docs-11, sumup-docs-12). No evidence of scoped or restricted credential issuance for agents.
